input: BL2 attempts to read the SoC PLL status register at offset 0x10C before the 1 ms lock time has elapsed. The read returns 0x00000000 (PLL not locked) and BL2 treats this as a fatal error and halts. The oscilloscope shows the PLL output frequency is actually stable. What is the correct procedure for polling PLL lock status and what minimum wait is required?
